paper_metadata.title: Effect of W on formation and properties of precipitates in Ni-based superalloys
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Iron and Steel Research International

evidence.quote: The formation and properties of precipitates in wrought Ni-based superalloys with different W contents during long-term exposure to high temperatures were investigated.
Three Ni-based alloys with different W contents (alloy 1, alloy 2, and alloy 3) were produced in a vacuum induction furnace and were cast into 25-kg ingots.
